title: Juicy Australian Chicken Stir-fry
description: A kid-friendly, herbal stir-fry dish featuring diced tomatoes and high-protein chicken, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces.
In a bowl, combine chili garlic sauce, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and minced ginger. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Heat peanut oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add chicken to the pan and stir-fry until golden brown on all sides.
Push chicken to one side of the pan and add diced tomatoes to the other side. Let cook for about 2 minutes, then mix everything together.
Pour in the sauce mixture and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for an additional 3-5 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly and everything is heated through.
Serve hot with steamed rice or noodles.
